mechanism: bounded adversarial lookahead, one ply each side, over the evader's legal replies from the strongest believed cell; the shipped barrier gate is untouched

severe_regression.analysis: Consistent and explained rather than incidental. Worst-case search is pessimistic by construction: it declines a close because the evader COULD step away. adversarial_corner is documented in the harness as a family that deliberately walks into tight regions - 'the case a pursuer should exploit and an evader should never choose' - so it is a probe of bad evader play, not realistic surviving behaviour. Against it the pessimism is unwarranted and costs captures the greedy policy would take.
severe_regression.gating_attempted: P7 gated the search on evader mobility. A gate at >=3 legal moves never fires (identical to ungated). A gate at >=4 reduces the regression to -19 on validation but also cuts the gain to +34 net from +57. The loss and the gain come from one mechanism and trade proportionally; the regression is not separable.
severe_regression.classification: artificial adversarial probe, not realistic important opponent behaviour

legality.hidden_state: none - reads only board, own position, quota and lawful scent belief
legality.opponent_identity: none - no group id, commit, repository or trajectory
legality.action_source: moves from legal_moves; barriers delegated to the shipped policy, which draws from is_placeable
